title: Subcontract an operation
route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Subcontracting ➔ Generate Subcontracting Purchase Documents

tokens.v: A production order's subcontracted operation gets a purchase order, its material is shipped to the subcontractor, and what comes back is received and used.

achieves.text: A production order's subcontracted operation gets a purchase order, its material is shipped to the subcontractor, and what comes back is received and used.

tokens.v: Set up operational subcontracting
, and a released production order for the finished item.

before.text: Set up operational subcontracting, and a released production order for the finished item.

tokens.v: The production order shows which operation is subcontracted. Generating the purchase documents makes a subcontracting purchase order for the item that comes back, with material supply lines for what goes out. Approving it makes a warehouse transfer to the subcontractor's warehouse; receiving the purchase order brings the item back and reports the operation's quantity.
